title: content/objects.yaml — object & item kinds carrying supply Effect (D9/D10), incl. flora + material tags + decay

tag.description: A core.Tag identifier. May contain a `:` namespace (e.g. `tool:cutting`, `station:bench`). MATERIAL tags (e.g. `shaft_stock`) make an item eligible for a recipe input tag-query (Materials plan §0/D4); substitutability emerges from tags. Cross-checked against the glossary/tag vocabulary at load (D10).

tagList.description: Material / tool / station tags carried by a kind (D4). A recipe input tag-query (content/recipes.yaml) is satisfied by any item_kind whose `tags` is a SUPERSET of the queried set — so a NEW item becomes a valid substitute purely by carrying the tag, no recipe edit (Materials plan §0). A tool item carries its tool tag here; a station object_kind carries its station tag here. De-duplicated; order not significant.

formula.description: A §6 Formula string (design.md §6), compiled by platform/config via engine/expr. Operands: terrain attrs, climate (moisture/temperature), the two morphology axes `length`/`width`, capability StatIDs (e.g. Dexterity). An unknown operand is a load-time failure (D10). Structural check here is non-empty string; semantic validation is platform/config's.

scalarOrFormula.description: Either a numeric constant or a §6 Formula string (engine/expr).

qtyRange.description: [min, max] inclusive integer quantity for a yield-table roll (seeded RNG). 0 <= min <= max (cross-field, enforced by platform/config beyond JSON Schema). The rolled qty is further scaled by the plant's `length` (taller ⇒ more wood; flora §1 refinement) — this is the base [min,max] before the length scaling.

yieldEntry.description: One yield-table row (flora 1e). `chance` is a §6 Formula (typically `§6(Dexterity)`) → [0,1] success probability for a SEEDED roll; `qty` is the base [min,max] amount on success, scaled by the plant's `length` (yield ∝ length, flora §1 refinement). D7: chance composes a capability stat, NOT a per-action skill. D9: regen is this table refilling as `length` grows, never a future-quantity field.

yieldTable.description: The yield table: an array of {item, chance, qty} rolled by a generic harvest action (Forage/Fell) with the seeded RNG (flora 1e, D12). Yield scales with the plant's `length` (flora §1 refinement).

shade.description: flora shade PARAMETER formulas (flora 1d + §1 refinement). radius/opacity = §6(width, species) — shade scales with CANOPY SPREAD (the `width` axis), NOT height. perception composes overlapping shade multiplicatively into LoS (no tiling, D11). engine/flora emits the parameter; perception computes the occlusion.

propagation.description: Seed-dispersal propagation (flora 1a option a): children spawn within `radius` of the parent Pos with probability `chance` · child_suitability · density_weight(neighbor_count). Environmental — NOT scaled by an actor stat.

decayTransform.description: What a decay STATE TRANSITION produces (Materials Q3 RESOLVED: transform, NOT vanish — D9 locality, mirrors flora regen→object). On entering this state, the source LOT is REPLACED by these output item_kind(s); the produced quantity is `qty · sourceLot.Qty` (Dm5(a): a lot of n rotting yields n·qty of the product). The terminal `gone` state OMITS transform (produces nothing — the only place decay removes mass). engine/decay emits the produced items as StepDeltas.Transformed; world (sole mutator) applies it. NOTE: a produced item that itself carries a `decay` block keeps aging (chained decay is data, not special-cased).

qty.description: Per-source-unit produced quantity; the actual emitted quantity is `qty · sourceLot.Qty` (Dm5(a)). Integer >= 1.

decayState.description: One ordered discrete decay state (Materials Q1 RESOLVED: discrete states fresh→stale→rotten→gone). The states array order IS the transition order. `name` is a label (NOT a separate id namespace — the state is identified by its INDEX in the ordered array, DERIVED from the lot's continuous decayAge accumulator, mirroring flora's derived Stage; D9 — never stored). `threshold` is the EFFECTIVE-DECAY-TIME measure (Dm1(a): env-independent effective-time units, NOT wall ticks) at which the lot ENTERS this state. `transform` is the product on entering this state (D9 locality, Q3). `supply` optionally OVERRIDES the item_kind's base supply for this state (e.g. stale food supplies less Satiety) — absent = unchanged.

threshold.description: Effective-decay-time measure (Dm1(a): EFFECTIVE-TIME units, env-independent — env/storage acceleration shows up as a faster decayAge advance, never a moving threshold) at which the lot ENTERS this state. The FIRST state (index 0, e.g. `fresh`) is the initial state and SHOULD omit threshold (or set 0). Strictly ascending across the array (enforced by platform/config beyond JSON Schema).

supply.description: Optional per-state supply OVERRIDE (the Effect this item delivers while in this state). Absent = use the item_kind base `supply`. Lets decay reduce nutritional value by state (D9: still a supply Effect on the object, no future field).

decay.description: Marks an item_kind as DECAYING (Materials & Crafting plan §0 locked; engine/decay; mirrors flora's data-driven §6 shape). Q1 RESOLVED discrete states; Q2 RESOLVED env-coupled acceleration; Q3 RESOLVED transform-on-transition; Dm1–Dm5 RESOLVED (a). The per-LOT runtime decay STATE (the continuous decayAge accumulator + derived state index) is NOT here (it is runtime state on the lot instance, like flora Length) — this block is the data RULES. Decay UNIT is a LOT `{kind, qty, decayAge}` (Dm5(a)); lots never auto-merge; a kind's inventory count is the SUM over its live lots.

baseRate.description: Base decay rate (data, Q2: 기본 rate는 데이터), in EFFECTIVE-DECAY-TIME units per tick at neutral env+storage. It is the FIRST multiplicative term of the effective rate (Dm2(a)): `effectiveRate = baseRate · accel(temperature,moisture) · storageRateMult`, and `decayAge += elapsedTicks · effectiveRate` per decay step (Dm1(a)).

accel.description: Env-coupled acceleration MULTIPLIER (Q2 + Dm2(a) RESOLVED): a single §6 Formula over the climate output operands `temperature`/`moisture` (the SAME Context operand names climate/flora use) → a scalar multiplier; cold+dry (low temp, low moisture) → < 1 (slows; cold-storage emerges, D2), warm+wet → > 1 (speeds). Composed MULTIPLICATIVELY: `effectiveRate = baseRate · accel · storageRateMult`. engine/decay OWNS + evaluates this Program via engine/expr (Dm3(a), flora parity). Optional (absent ⇒ accel = 1, env has no effect). Domain clamp (≥ 0) is engine/decay's (climate/flora clamp contract).

states.description: The ordered discrete decay states (Q1: fresh→stale→rotten→gone). Order IS the transition order; index 0 is the initial state (decayAge=0). minItems 2 (an item that decays has at least an initial + a decayed state). Strictly-ascending thresholds enforced by platform/config (beyond JSON Schema).

flora.description: Marks an object_kind as a flora SPECIES (engine/flora; docs/flora.md). All behavior is §6 data (D4/D10); succession/forests emerge (D2/D3). TWO continuous morphology axes (§1 refinement, replacing the single `growth` scalar): `length` (height; maturity proxy → stages; yield ∝ length) and `width` (canopy spread → shade), each with its OWN growth rate so a species can grow tall faster than wide. Stages DERIVED from `length` via `stages` thresholds (D9: no stored stage, no future field).

length_rate.description: §6/scalar HEIGHT growth rate: Length += length_rate · suitability per flora step (§1 refinement, 1b). Independent of width_rate (tall-vs-wide shape).

width_rate.description: §6/scalar GIRTH/CANOPY growth rate: Width += width_rate · suitability per flora step (§1 refinement, 1b). Independent of length_rate.

stages.description: Ascending Length thresholds (world units, > 0) → derived discrete stage index (count+1 stages). Stage is over HEIGHT (`length`), NOT width (§1 refinement). platform/config enforces strictly ascending (beyond JSON Schema).

yield_stage.description: Minimum derived stage index at which harvest.yields apply (e.g. only mature plants bear fruit). Optional; default 0.

propagate_stage.description: Minimum derived stage index at which the plant disperses seed (propagation). Optional; default 0.

death_threshold.description: θ: suitability below this counts toward death (1b). [0,1].

death_hysteresis.description: Consecutive sub-θ flora steps before object-mortality removal (1b option a; no flicker). >= 1.

yields.description: Either the LEGACY single item id (non-flora object_kinds: a fixed item placed into inventory) OR the flora YIELD TABLE [{item, chance, qty}] rolled with the seeded RNG (flora 1e; qty ∝ length, §1 refinement). platform/config picks the form by shape.

perishable.description: Whether this item decays. A `perishable: true` item SHOULD carry a `decay` block (the decay RULES); a `decay` block requires `perishable: true` (platform/config cross-checks). Materials plan §0: perishability is now data-driven via `decay`, generalizing the legacy boolean.
